_doc: The Vos Syndicate's line (mockup 37): the specialists Boarder, Drum, Cross, Deck runner and Broadside, and the fighters Cutter (the standard fighter), Twin boom (the shuttle stand-in and bomber) and Stack. Each unwrapped and baked onto its own UVs by tools/blender/painted_bake.py --ship (never edited by hand): the UV mesh in ship space (+x port, +y up, +z bow, metres) and its painted colour, AO and glow maps. uv_m is metres of hull per UV unit.
